evals.name: scaffold-early-exit
evals.prompt: I'm about to start building out the project at /Users/ryan/Code/killallgit/killall-router. Before we touch anything, prime yourself on it: take stock of the project at a high level so we don't burn context exploring later. Write the result to map.md.
evals.expected_output: A terse list (ten to twenty lines) saying the project is a FastAPI + deepagents scaffold with almost no code yet (one package with five modules, three tests, uv, Taskfile, no commits), naming the app factory, the test command, and the declared-but-unused langchain-openrouter dependency, and stopping there. No reads beyond the survey, no subagents.
expectations: map is brief for a scaffold: at most 30 non-empty lines
names FastAPI and deepagents as the stack
names the app factory (create_app / killall_router.app / app.py) as the entrypoint
states that nothing has been committed yet
gives the test command (uv run pytest or task test)
names the Taskfile or uv as the tooling
map is a terse list: no content line over 200 characters, average under 120
spawned no subagents
prime added under 50k tokens to the session (final context minus starting context)

evals.name: small-python-cli
evals.prompt: Prime yourself on /Users/ryan/Code/archae0pteryx/filescan before we start work — I want a map of how it's actually built (structure, entrypoints, patterns, deps, how to run tests), not a rewrite of the README. Put the map in map.md.
evals.expected_output: A terse list of about forty one-line facts: a Click CLI (filescan/cli.py, pyproject script filescan = filescan.cli:main) with pure modules (walk, fingerprint, discover, dirsig, archive, export, report), types.py as the hub of frozen dataclasses and StrEnums, db.py plus sqlite3 use in fingerprint.py/cli.py contradicting CLAUDE.md, xxhash/rich/click as the libraries, the scripts (01-move-extras.sh, 02-delete-recycle.sh, visual_dedup.py with its undeclared image deps), the test/lint commands (uv run --extra dev pytest / ruff), and gotchas such as the 32MB master.db in the root and the uncommitted work.
expectations: names filescan/cli.py (filescan.cli:main) as the entrypoint
identifies Click as the CLI framework
identifies db.py as the SQLite/database module
flags that sqlite3 is also used in fingerprint.py or cli.py, contradicting CLAUDE.md's 'db.py only' claim
gives the pytest command via uv
names ruff as the linter
flags a working-tree gotcha: uncommitted changes, master.db in the root, or the second venv
map is at most 60 non-empty lines
names at least three pipeline modules (walk, fingerprint, discover, dirsig, archive, export, report, volume, excludes)
notes frozen dataclasses or StrEnum in types.py
names a script under scripts/ (01-move-extras.sh, 02-delete-recycle.sh, visual_dedup.py)
names xxhash or rich as a load-bearing library
map is a terse list: no content line over 200 characters, average under 120
spawned no subagents
prime added under 50k tokens to the session (final context minus starting context)

evals.name: large-fastapi-with-siblings
evals.prompt: We're going to be working in /Users/ryan/Code/eyepop/eyepop-web-api for the next while. Run a priming pass first: figure out how the project is actually structured, trace the entrypoints, note the patterns and load-bearing libraries, how tests run, and which of the other repos next to it in /Users/ryan/Code/eyepop it's actually related to. Save the map as map.md.
evals.expected_output: A terse list of about forty one-line facts: FastAPI app built in app/main.py (lifespan wires eyeballs config, DB, jobs), domain-organized app/ packages (clouds, billing, accounts, auth, users, pops...), config/settings.py as the settings hub, Tortoise ORM models in db/models with Aerich migrations in db/migrations over MySQL, startup jobs gated by settings.disable_jobs, Docker entrypoint via scripts/entrypoint.sh (gunicorn + uvicorn workers), tests co-located under app/ (pytest, MySQL on :3307), commands from the Taskfile/Makefile (task check/test/lint:ci/typecheck), useful scripts (localdev.sh, testdb.sh, setup-db.sh, export_openapi.py), load-bearing deps with usage counts (tortoise-orm, fastapi, pydantic, eyepop-eyeballs, stripe, sentry-sdk), declared-but-unused deps, and related repos with evidence (eyepop-eyeballs as a git dependency; eyepop-wiki/charts/testing as clients or deployers). Watch-outs such as the private dependency needing GH_TOKEN, the relaxed typecheck, and the checkout behind origin/main.
expectations: identifies app/main.py as where the FastAPI app is built
identifies Tortoise ORM with Aerich migrations
names db/models and db/migrations
describes app/ as domain-organized, naming at least three domain packages
gives a test command (task test / task check / pytest) and notes tests need MySQL
names fastapi, tortoise and at least one of auth0/stripe/google-cloud as load-bearing
identifies eyepop-eyeballs as a sibling that is a direct dependency
names at least one more related sibling repo (actions, sdk, vercel, charts, billing, pipeline, testing, instance, developer-mcp, apps, wiki, cli)
flags the private dependency / GH_TOKEN requirement or the relaxed typecheck as a watch-out
notes the gunicorn/uvicorn launch via scripts/entrypoint.sh
notes startup jobs gated by disable_jobs / DISABLE_JOBS
map is at most 70 non-empty lines
names a useful script beyond entrypoint.sh (localdev, test.sh, testdb, setup-db, seed, migrate, export_openapi, debug-local-db, start-db)
names config/settings.py as the settings hub
map is a terse list: no content line over 200 characters, average under 120
spawned no subagents
prime added under 50k tokens to the session (final context minus starting context)
